pairs: Tu autem,
“But as for you,
fili hominis,
son of man,
vaticinare adversum Gog,
prophesy against Gog,
et dices:
and you shall say:
Hæc dicit Dominus Deus:
Thus says the Lord God:
Ecce ego super te,
Behold,
Gog,
I am above you,
principem capitis Mosoch
O Gog,
et Thubal.
prince of the head of Meshech and Tubal.
Et circumagam te,
And I will turn you around,
et educam te,
and I will lead you away,
et ascendere te faciam de lateribus aquilonis,
and I will cause you to rise up from the parts of the north.
et adducam te super montes Israël.
And I will bring you over the mountains of Israel.
Et percutiam arcum tuum in manu sinistra tua,
And I will strike your bow in your left hand,
et sagittas tuas de manu dextera tua dejiciam.
and I will cast away your arrows from your right hand.
Super montes Israël cades tu,
You will fall upon the mountains of Israel,
et omnia agmina tua,
you and all your companies,
et populi tui qui sunt tecum: feris,
and your peoples who are with you. I have given you over to the wild animals,
avibus,
to the birds,
omnique volatili et bestiis terræ dedi te ad devorandum.
and to every flying thing, and to the beasts of the earth, in order to be devoured.
Super faciem agri cades,
You will fall upon the face of the field.
quia ego locutus sum,
For I have spoken,
ait Dominus Deus.
says the Lord God.
Et immittam ignem in Magog,
And I will send a fire upon Magog,
et in his qui habitant in insulis confidenter:
and upon those who are living confidently in the islands.
et scient quia ego Dominus.
And they shall know that I am the Lord.
Et nomen sanctum meum notum faciam in medio populi mei Israël,
And I will make known my holy name in the midst of my people,
et non polluam nomen sanctum meum amplius:
Israel, and my holy name will no longer be defiled.
et scient gentes quia ego Dominus,
And the Gentiles shall know that I am the Lord,
Sanctus Israël.
the Holy One of Israel.
Ecce venit,
Behold, it approaches,
et factum est,
and it is done,
ait Dominus Deus:
says the Lord God.
hæc est dies de qua locutus sum.
This is the day, about which I have spoken.
Et egredientur habitatores de civitatibus Israël,
And the inhabitants from the cities of Israel will go forth,
et succendent et comburent arma,
and they will kindle and burn the weapons,
clypeum et hastas,
the shields and the spears,
arcum et sagittas,
the bows and the arrows,
et baculos manuum et contos:
and the staff and the lance.
et succendent ea igni septem annis.
And they will kindle fires with them for seven years.
Et non portabunt ligna de regionibus,
And they will not carry wood from the countryside,
neque succident de saltibus:
and they will not cut from the forests.
quoniam arma succendent igni,
For they will kindle the weapons with fire.
et deprædabuntur eos quibus prædæ fuerant,
And they will prey upon those who had preyed upon them,
et diripient vastatores suos,
and they will plunder those who had plundered them,
ait Dominus Deus.
says the Lord God.
Et erit in die illa:
And this shall be in that day:
dabo Gog locum nominatum sepulchrum in Israël,
I will give Gog a renowned place as a sepulcher in Israel,
vallem viatorum ad orientem maris,
the valley of the wayfarers to the east of the sea,
quæ obstupescere faciet prætereuntes:
which will cause astonishment in those who pass by.
et sepelient ibi Gog,
And in that place,
et omnem multitudinem ejus,
they will bury Gog and all his multitude,
et vocabitur vallis multitudinis Gog.
and it will be called the valley of the multitude of Gog.
Et sepelient eos domus Israël,
And the house of Israel will bury them,
ut mundent terram septem mensibus.
so that they may cleanse the land, for seven months.
Sepeliet autem eum omnis populus terræ:
Then all the people of the earth will bury them,
et erit eis nominata dies in qua glorificatus sum,
and this shall be for them a renowned day, on which I have been glorified,
ait Dominus Deus.
says the Lord God.
Et viros jugiter constituent lustrantes terram,
And they shall appoint men to continually examine the earth,
qui sepeliant et requirant eos qui remanserant super faciem terræ,
so that they may seek out and bury those who have remained on the surface of the earth,
ut emundent eam:
so that they may cleanse it.
post menses autem septem quærere incipient.
Then, after seven months, they will begin to seek.
Et circuibunt peragrantes terram:
And they will go around, traveling the earth.
cumque viderint os hominis,
And when they will have seen the bone of a man,
statuent juxta illud titulum,
they will station a marker beside it,
donec sepeliant illud pollinctores in valle multitudinis Gog.
until the undertakers may bury it in the valley of the multitude of Gog.
Nomen autem civitatis Amona:
And the name of the city will be: the Multitude.
et mundabunt terram.
And they shall cleanse the earth.
Tu ergo,
As for you,
fili hominis,
then, son of man,
hæc dicit Dominus Deus: Dic omni volucri,
thus says the Lord God: Say to every flying thing,
et universis avibus,
and to all the birds,
cunctisque bestiis agri: Convenite,
and to all the beasts of the field:
properate,
Assemble! Hurry!
concurrite undique ad victimam meam quam ego immolo vobis,
Rush together from every side to my victim, which I have immolated for you,
victimam grandem super montes Israël,
a great victim upon the mountains of Israel,
ut comedatis carnem, et bibatis sanguinem.
so that you may consume flesh, and drink blood!
Carnes fortium comedetis,
You shall eat the flesh of the powerful,
et sanguinem principum terræ bibetis:
and you shall drink the blood of the princes of the earth,
arietum, et agnorum, et hircorum,
of rams and lambs and he-goats and bulls,
taurorumque et altilium, et pinguium omnium.
and of fattened birds and all that is fat.
Et comedetis adipem in saturitatem,
And you shall consume the fat unto satiation,
et bibetis sanguinem in ebrietatem,
and you shall drink the blood unto inebriation,
de victima quam ego immolabo vobis:
from the victim that I will immolate for you.
et saturabimini super mensam meam de equo,
And you shall be satiated, upon my table,
et equite forti, et de universis viris bellatoribus,
from horses and powerful horsemen, and from all the men of war,
ait Dominus Deus.
says the Lord God.
Et ponam gloriam meam in gentibus:
And I will set my glory among the Gentiles.
et videbunt omnes gentes judicium meum quod fecerim,
And all the nations shall see my judgment, which I have accomplished,
et manum meam quam posuerim super eos.
and my hand, which I have laid upon them.
Et scient domus Israël quia ego Dominus Deus eorum,
And the house of Israel shall know that I am the Lord,
a die illa
their God,
et deinceps.
from that day and thereafter.
Et scient gentes quoniam in iniquitate sua capta sit domus Israël,
And the Gentiles shall know that the house of Israel was taken captive because of their own iniquity,
eo quod dereliquerint me,
because they abandoned me.
et absconderim faciem meam ab eis,
And so I concealed my face from them,
et tradiderim eos in manus hostium,
and I delivered them into the hands of their enemies,
et ceciderint in gladio universi.
and they all fell by the sword.
Juxta immunditiam eorum et scelus feci eis,
I have acted toward them in accord with their uncleanness and wickedness,
et abscondi faciem meam ab illis.
and so I concealed my face from them.
Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus:
Because of this, thus says the Lord God:
Nunc reducam captivitatem Jacob,
Now I will lead back the captivity of Jacob,
et miserebor omnis domus Israël,
and I will take pity upon the entire house of Israel.
et assumam zelum pro nomine sancto meo.
And I will act with zeal on behalf of my holy name.
Et portabunt confusionem suam,
And they shall bear their shame and all their transgression,
et omnem prævaricationem qua prævaricati sunt in me,
by which they betrayed me,
cum habitaverint in terra sua confidenter,
though they were living in their own land confidently,
neminem formidantes:
dreading no one.
et reduxero eos de populis,
And I will lead them back from among the peoples,
et congregavero de terris inimicorum suorum,
and I will gather them together from the lands of their enemies,
et sanctificatus fuero in eis,
and I will be sanctified in them,
in oculis gentium plurimarum.
in the sight of the many nations.
Et scient quia ego Dominus Deus eorum,
And they shall know that I am the Lord, their God,
eo quod transtulerim eos in nationes,
because I carried them away to the nations,
et congregaverim eos super terram suam,
and I gathered them upon their own land,
et non dereliquerim quemquam ex eis ibi.
and I did not abandon any of them there.
Et non abscondam ultra faciem meam ab eis,
And I will no longer conceal my face from them,
eo quod effuderim spiritum meum super omnem domum Israël,
for I have poured out my Spirit upon the entire house of Israel,
ait Dominus Deus.
says the Lord God.”
